n1.vlm_desc: A realistic natural scene photograph of an urban street in daylight with buildings, road, and a few vehicles/pedestrians; natural colors, photographic lighting; no overlays, no bounding boxes, no annotations, no text.

n2.vlm_desc: A minimal flat-design tag/list icon representing image-level labels: a small rounded card with several bullet lines and tiny tag symbols; clean vector style, light background with dark gray strokes and a small accent color; no readable text characters.

n3.pptx_intent: Rounded rectangle module box with text 'Patch Embedding (Small Patches)'. Include a small simple grid pictogram (fine patch grid) inside/right of the box; primary blue outline/fill tint, dark text.

n4.pptx_intent: Small rounded rectangle or token block highlighted (accent color) with text 'Loc Token', shown as appended to a short row of small token blocks (simple rectangles) indicating a token sequence.

n5.pptx_intent: Large rounded rectangle container labeled 'SegFormer Backbone'. Add a simple stacked multi-scale feature pyramid icon on the right side (3–4 vertical bars/blocks of decreasing size). Scientific blue styling.

n6.pptx_intent: Small plug-in/sidecar module: rounded rectangle labeled 'Adapter' visually attached to a small feature-map icon (stacked rectangles). Use accent highlight for the adapter to indicate add-on.

n7.pptx_intent: Rounded rectangle labeled 'Cls Head' with a small simple logits icon to the right (mini bar chart with 4–6 bars). Keep bars as simple shapes (no axes).

n8.pptx_intent: Hexagon loss node labeled 'L_cls'. Optionally add a small sigma/aggregation icon (simple Σ-like glyph or small circle+lines) as a tiny pictogram; keep editable text.

n9.pptx_intent: Rounded rectangle labeled 'Decoder' with an icon showing pyramid features transforming into a dense map (stacked small blocks arrowing toward a single filled rectangle).

n10.vlm_desc: The same kind of street photo as the input, with a semi-transparent semantic segmentation overlay: distinct solid colors per class forming regions (e.g., road, building, car, person), clean boundaries, typical segmentation mask appearance; no legend, no text.

n11.pptx_intent: Rounded rectangle labeled 'Patch Clustering' with a small scatter-plot-like icon inside: a few colored dot groups (3 clusters) without axes labels; keep it as simple editable dots.

n12.pptx_intent: Database cylinder shape labeled 'Memory Bank' with a few small feature-vector icons (tiny stacked rectangles or short lines) inside/near it; standard scientific diagram styling.

n13.pptx_intent: Rounded rectangle labeled 'Pseudo-label Gen' with a small mask/confidence icon: a rectangle subdivided into regions where some are bold/colored (confident) and others light/gray (uncertain). Keep icon as simple shapes.

n14.vlm_desc: A standalone segmentation-style mask image: only confident regions are colored with distinct class colors while the rest of the image is gray or transparent-looking; crisp region shapes; no text, no legend, no photo background required (mask-focused).

n15.pptx_intent: Hexagon loss node labeled 'L_ce'. Add a tiny cross-entropy pictogram: two small simplified distributions (two mini bar sets) or target vs prediction icon using simple bars; editable text.
